name: Activation / Grounding
description: Grounding and activation tool to bring the rider back into their body and into the present moment while riding.
instructions: Put your horse in a safe, simple context (halt or easy walk) if activation is high.

Use this grounding focus: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Name 3 things you see; light bilateral taps for 60–90s. Ground feet, micro-move, add energy with voice cue..  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
Continue for the suggested duration, then reassess your activation level and your horse's response.
evidence_base: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), grounding techniques, and sports psychology arousal management.
